# MMM paired-evidence transfer v1: targeted acquisition fails

The [frozen feasibility protocol](mmm-member-pair-feasibility-v1-protocol.md)
**fails** on independent design and confirmation streams generated by the
existing MMM member label rule. The v4 paired-betting gate is unchanged.
Passive bit-2 matching provides too few contemporaneous pairs; targeted
same-cell reference acquisition doubles usable pairs at its declared
context-read cost, but does not recover enough power for a member split.
Do not wire this gate into actual Anti-Pigeon authorization on this evidence.

## Boundary and audit

The opt-in [Go harness](../../internal/observationgate/member_pair_feasibility_v1_test.go)
reuses `integrationLabel` from the existing member integration test and
the existing five scenario definitions. It makes no serving or model-state
change. Every nomination and reference-context selection occurs before
revealing labels. A label arriving without its matched partner counts as
acquisition cost but never reaches the gate. Only a complete pair with
the same origin clock and bit-2 context cell changes its wealth.

- [Design JSONL](mmm-member-pair-feasibility-v1-design.jsonl): 10,000 trials, SHA256 `eb70a311a19dd90a6230a61f6948f259d4846df7e28dd5f1454bbceea45191de`.
- [Confirmation JSONL](mmm-member-pair-feasibility-v1-confirmation.jsonl): 10,000 fresh trials, SHA256 `2908be301bf257d47460fb03d8315bd930c1d8f4a249593d84a70bb3bde37321`.
- The [independent verifier](../../research/member-pair-feasibility-v1-verify.mjs)
  checks source/protocol hashes, every row key and resource invariant, and
  reconstructs all summary cells. Confirmation replays all 10,002 JSONL
  entries exactly after excluding elapsed time. This replay uses the same
  simulator, not an independent implementation of the e-process.

## Confirmation result

| Case | Passive flags / 1,000 | Targeted flags / 1,000 | Targeted median flag clock |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Stable | 0 | 2 | 392 |
| Member-only shift at 256 | **5** | **108** | 477 |
| Common shift at 256 | 0 | 0 | none |
| Recurring live shift | 2 | 44 | 457 |
| Null labels | 0 | 0 | none |

No member-only shift flags preceded clock 256. The targeted member-shift
rate is 10.8% (per-cell Wilson 95% interval about 9.0%-12.9%), far below
the frozen 80% power floor. Design was similar: 3/1,000 passive and
126/1,000 targeted member-shift flags. A median clock conditional on only
108 flags is not a useful population detection delay; the other 892
trajectories never flagged by the horizon. All declared null cells pass
their empirical false-flag screen, but that does not rescue power.

At confirmation, passive matching gives about 64 nominated same-cell
pairs and 39 complete pairs per trajectory; targeted matching gives about
128 matched nominations and 78 complete pairs. Both modes acquire about
198-199 arrived labels per trajectory. The live frame context is read at
all 512 clocks in this generator. Targeted reference acquisition uses
about 256 context proposals for 128 nominations, versus 128 proposals
passively, meeting the frozen 2.1-proposals-per-nomination cost ceiling.
The run took about 0.83 seconds per 10,000-trial split in the isolated Go
harness; this excludes MMM forecasting, fits, storage, contention and
serving p99.

## Why v4 did not transfer

Bit-2 matching is valid for this generator's *conditional marginal* law:
the other eight bits are independently uniform on both sides. It is not
full-frame equality or a causal intervention. Before a member shift, the
parity rule is Bernoulli(0.5) conditional on bit 2. After the shift, the
live rule is Bernoulli(0.95) or Bernoulli(0.05), giving a conditional mean
gap of 0.45. The v4 successful toy used a 0.80 gap. Under the frozen
0.8 bet, the expected favorable log factor per completed pair is about
0.163 here versus 0.403 in v4; this calculation is an inference from
the declared generator, not a measured theorem for external streams.
Only about half of targeted completed pairs arrive after clock 256, and
those are divided between two context cells. The fixed 32-process
threshold is therefore rarely reached before clock 512. Lowering it
after these results would invalidate the frozen error allocation.

## Decision

Goal 3 remains open. This is a prerequisite acquisition/identifiability
study, not actual MMM member-state integration and not a downstream Brier
or answer-quality test. The next research candidate should predeclare
competing conditional hypotheses and nominate observations that
differentiate them at a fixed *total* acquisition cost, with an
outcome-blind selection rule and a valid selection/arrival proof. It
must also test whether an actual member split improves scored forecasts;
an evidence flag alone is insufficient. Production and the whitepaper
remain untouched.
